coverageSpotVerification.detail: Read every mapped test body in scripts/acceptance.mts and scripts/m2..m8-tests.mts and re-executed all 29 sampled assertions myself. Every mapping exercises the observable it claims, and my independent result agreed with the suite on all 29. Four mappings are thinner than the assertion text without being dishonest, and I closed each gap independently: m2-a13 proves "no preview card" by the absence of a *preview-card* testID (self-referential — I re-checked the rendered card HTML); m2-a16 asserts repost attribution on the API projection rather than the rendered "reposted by" string (the choreography assertion repost-toggle-live-attribution and my own feed read cover the rendered form); m4-a07 removes the reaction through the documented emoji:null path rather than a literal re-tap (I confirmed the UI re-tap removes it); m6-a08 asserts the push payload while the recipient still holds an open client, so it never establishes the assertion’s "with Bob’s clients closed" precondition (I verified the gate fires only when no client is connected). The manifest also lists no suite-required assertion it does not cover: every milestone receipt reported missing:[].

defects.summary: Tapping a quoted excerpt silently does nothing when the quoted message is outside the loaded history page. src/Messaging.tsx implements onPressQuote as document.getElementById("message-"+m.replyTo)?.scrollIntoView(...), so when the source has been paged out the optional chain swallows the miss: no scroll, no older-page fetch, no feedback.

O1.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("M1-M4 solid, later milestones patchy or failed on cap") and the 90 anchor ("every in-scope milestone green, including platform-proof artifacts").
O1.justification: 100 of the 116 in-scope atomic assertions passed under my own execution (M1 13/13, M2 27/27, M3 14/15, M4 12/12, M5 12/12, M6 6/13, M7 0/9, M8 16/18). M1-M5 are solid well past the 60 anchor and M6 and M8 are web-green with their suites and choreography segments re-run green by me. Two things hold it below 90, both of which that anchor names explicitly: M7 was never attempted, so a whole in-scope milestone scores its checklist not-passed (9 assertions); and the native/simulator platform-proof artifacts are absent, so M6’s seven cold-start offline assertions and M8’s two durable-queue-restart assertions have no harness receipt and cannot be passed (evidence/m6-choreography-1789061365712.jsonl and evidence/m8-choreography-1789063651570.jsonl both record supplementalExternal status "not-recorded"). The single M3 miss (m3-a02) is a contract-excused 1:1 bubble layout choice and carries no defect.

O2.anchorsCited: Between the 60 anchor ("a few medium defects off the happy path") and the 90 anchor ("only cosmetic nits"), close to 90.
O2.justification: Beyond the checklist I found no blocker and no major defect: two minor (d-01 quoted-excerpt jump no-ops across a history page boundary; d-02 raw engine constraint string shown as the duplicate-handle error) and one cosmetic (d-03 trailing empty pagination page). Sixteen grader-written trust-boundary probes were all correctly denied server-side — private DM reads/writes, in-chat and global search leakage, non-author edit and delete, non-admin member add, handle takeover through updateMyProfile, cross-user digest and push rows, post-removal delivery and writes, third-party view-once asset records, stale-nonce revival of cleared like state, and explicit self-follow. Push previews do not leak view-once captions. It falls short of "only cosmetic nits" because d-01 and d-02 are real functional/UX faults, not nits.

O4.anchorsCited: Between the 30 anchor ("cold-start offline shows an empty or broken app") and the 60 anchor ("reads work; offline writes lost or mis-ordered, or receipts wrong after flush"); the 90 anchor ("... all behave as specced on the native proof - on full runs including M8’s durable-queue restart and multi-device convergence evidence") is unreachable because the native proof does not exist.
O4.justification: O4 reads only the harness’s mechanically checkable artifacts. The simulator artifact was never recorded: both the M6 and M8 segment summaries carry supplementalExternal {status:"not-recorded", pass:null, receipt:null}, and the brief is explicit that missing evidence leaves the native proof absent rather than passing it, so the entire cold-start half of this dimension is unproven. Everything the harness did mechanically verify passed cleanly: m6 offline-message-queue-flush-in-order (flushMs 844.6), m5 warm-offline-search-over-synced-messages (1388 ms), m5 disappearing-message-expiry-and-purge (189194 ms), and on M8 m8-a15-dual-offline-convergence (both clients’ writes settled in server-arrival order, firstFlushMs 948.0 / secondFlushMs 935.7, no loss and no duplicates) with m8-a16-dual-offline-receipts advancing normally afterwards. I also independently reproduced warm-offline search and reconnect purge on the web build. That is materially better than the 60 anchor’s failure clause on the surface that was demonstrated, but roughly half the dimension’s observable has no proof at all. The honesty half of the dimension is exemplary: the gap is declared in instrument-skips.json, in the run record’s notes, and in the harness’s own structured receipt, and no native claim is made anywhere.

O5.bandRationale: First-match over the frozen order 0, 30, 60, 90, 75. Branch 0 does not fire: the invariant manifest conforms at all three checkpoints (evidence/scale-10%-verification.json, scale-50%-verification.json, scale-final-verification.json each report pass with an empty failures array, and the final actual counts equal the frozen expectedState.perEntityCounts field for field), I independently re-verified every named O5 fixture against the scale instance on 52102 (u0500 following 500 / 100 conversations, u0005 following 5, u0900 900 followers and 200 top-level posts, u0901 following 5, g0001 50 members and exactly 10000 messages), the replay completed 167244 actions (167157 scale plus the 87 starter actions) rather than aborting, and the instrument’s replay wall cap is still a P3 "pilot-calibrated" placeholder so it cannot have been exhausted. Branch 30 does not fire: every measured degradation rule passes with margin - deep-history page 50 vs page 1 ratio 0.98, 500-follow vs 5-follow feed 2.33, search growth 0.90 with the 50% checkpoint at 2.91 ms below the line, celebrity write 1.34, celebrity read 1.14, all against a 3x bound - and no probe timed out, errored or OOMed. Branch 60 does not fire and branch 90 cannot be established for the same reason: the brief’s absolute p95 ceiling table and the replay wall cap are both uncalibrated P3 placeholders, so no ceiling can be exceeded and no ceiling utilization or cap fraction can be shown to be at or below 50%. 90 requires an affirmative condition that this pre-freeze instrument cannot supply, so the total function falls through to 75. Recorded limitation: the M8 Insights and Trending growth rules could not be evaluated at all, because the lane did not author those queries when the 10% and 50% checkpoints were live; their full-corpus p95 values (insights 1.10 ms, trending 3.17 ms) are clean but their growth curves are unmeasured, and unmeasured is not the same as failed.

notes: N=1 calibration run, not a claim-eligible wave. Three recorded deviations from the frozen grader prompt. (1) No holdout probe set was committed for this wave, so execution-order phase 4 was skipped: wave.probeSetSha256 is the sentinel "none-uncommitted", probeResults is empty, and no probes were invented. Because applicability.json makes O3 scorable only from the wave’s secret rotated probes ("anchor probes are non-scored continuity diagnostics and never bear on O3"), O3 records null even though its applicability predicate (M6 green plus M1-M5 attempted) is satisfied; scoring it from my own trust-boundary probes would substitute a different instrument. My 16 trust-boundary spot checks are reported as O2 evidence instead, and all were correctly denied. (2) The claude family has not passed the grader calibration gate, so calibrationPassed is false and this grade is labelled uncalibrated-grader; sameFamilyGraded is false (the builder harness is recorded as gpt-6-astra). (3) Timing-sensitive checks are best-of-3; host load (uptime) is recorded beside every measurement I took in grading/trace.md. The machine was shared throughout, with 1-minute load averages between 12.0 and 20.2. Schema limitation: assertionResults restricts keys to ^m[1-7]-a[0-9]{2}$, so this report cannot key M8 even though applicability.json puts M8 in a full run’s O1/O2 scope. I executed all 18 M8 assertions anyway and they are recorded in grading/trace.md and counted in O1: m8-a01 and m8-a03 to m8-a07 verified independently against a grader-built corpus; m8-a02 and m8-a13 to m8-a16 pass from evidence/m8-choreography-1789063651570.jsonl; m8-a08 to m8-a12 verified by my own shortened-config digest runs, including an owned-backend restart mid-period that produced exactly one digest row; m8-a17 and m8-a18 are not-run for the same missing-native-artifact reason as m6-a01 to m6-a07. I also verified that the lane’s copy of the choreography harness differs from the frozen instrument only in two path repairs (fixtures directory and a json-schema import backed by a real AJV 2020 validator) with no assertion logic changed, and that its vendored UI-kit edits are React-Native-Web accessibility passthrough (aria-valuetext / aria-selected mirroring the same accessibilityValue) plus one disclosed aria-label on the chat-background preview; the harness’s independent loaded-media check still gates that assertion, so none of the edits bypasses an outcome. Ports used and released: 52100 (lane backend), 52101 (lane web client), 52102 (scale instance). Builder suite receipts were backed up before I re-ran the suites and restored afterwards; my own receipts are retained under grading/raw/.
